scope: Read-only reconciliation of all original 37 pending tasks through recorded PR185–194 candidate evidence; no executions, status mutation or publication assertion.

publication.condition: Separate exact-head CI/merge/deployment manifest and public HTTPS verification required; candidate checks do not prove publication.

entries.parentAcceptance: CADまたは閉じた表面から体積メッシュを生成。品質、局所細分化、部分領域への適合を検証。
entries.parentAcceptanceEn: Generate volume elements from CAD or closed surfaces; verify quality, local sizing and conformity to partial regions.
entries.assessmentJa: 限定Tet境界検査は追加済み。一般CAD体積化・局所細分・部分領域適合は残る。
entries.assessmentEn: Bounded Tet checks exist; general CAD volume meshing, local sizing and region conformity remain.

entries.parentAcceptance: 表面上の領域を寸法で定義し、境界適合と面積誤差を検証。再メッシュ後も指定を維持。 2026-10-16 円錐領域: 既存の円筒領域指定に任意の終端半径を追加し、STEPの円錐で荷重保存・面積検証・保存/復元をテスト、実Chromeでも円錐STEPの受理と誤った終端半径の拒否(メッシュ時)を確認。球面帯sectorは2026-10-19追加（下記）。一般UV矩形は未実装。円錐STEPで終端半径を空欄にした場合の条件文の表示は要確認。
entries.parentAcceptanceEn: Define dimensional surface regions and verify boundary/area errors and persistence after remeshing. 2026-10-16 Cones: an optional end radius on the existing cylindrical region, tested on a STEP cone (force conservation, area verification, save/restore) and in real Chrome (cone STEP accepted, wrong end radius refused at mesh time). Spherical sectors added2026-10-19 (below); general UV rectangles remain unimplemented. The condition text for a blank end radius on a cone needs a check.
entries.assessmentJa: 空欄/明示円錐半径の日英条件文と再適用は実確認済み。一般UV矩形・一般曲面精度は残る。
entries.assessmentEn: Blank/explicit cone-radius text and reapply checked in JA/EN; general UV rectangles and curved accuracy remain.

entries.parentAcceptance: 単純参照形状から粗い牛型へ進み、版・配布条件・壁/遠方境界・メッシュ・停止・入出力契約を固定。速度・圧力・抗力・質量収支と領域/メッシュ/時間依存性を検証する。Stokes設定変更や未検証の層流仮定で代替せず、公開経路を待たせない。 2026-10-16: SU2 任意経路(取得は明示実行・固定SHA-256、同梱しない、LGPL-2.1表示)をmainへ反映(PR7)。実験的で上記の未達は変わらない。
entries.parentAcceptanceEn: Progress from simple references to rough cow geometry, fixing version/distribution, wall/far-field boundaries, mesh, cancellation and I/O contracts. Verify velocity, pressure, drag, mass balance and domain/mesh/time dependence. Do not substitute Stokes settings or unverified laminar assumptions; do not delay publication work. 2026-10-16: The opt-in SU2 path (explicit download with a pinned SHA-256, not bundled, LGPL-2.1 notice) is merged (PR 7). Experimental; the open items above are unchanged.
entries.assessmentJa: 追加SU2起動2/2消費。N144も全受入不成立。離散流束取得・格子収束・牛精度は未完。
entries.assessmentEn: SU2 additional launch budget exhausted 2/2; N144 did not pass all gates. Discrete flux, mesh convergence and cow accuracy remain.

entries.parentAcceptance: 熱応力、振動からの音の放射、共役熱伝達を段階的に追加。メッシュ間の転送・保存則も検証。
entries.parentAcceptanceEn: Add thermal stress, vibration sound radiation and conjugate heat transfer with conservative mesh transfers.

entries.parentAcceptance: 材料モデルと試験データに基づき、個別に検証。材料名や最大応力だけから破断を保証しない。

entries.parentAcceptanceEn: Compare two cases with shared camera/field/range/scale/stored time. Implemented API/GUI PNG/orbit-WebM, hashed artifact retrieval/cancel/release and portable manual JSON/CAS settings. Added opt-in browser-local saving of one preset (128 KiB) and explicit restoration of reload candidates; cases, media and credentials are not saved. Localhost real Chrome verified PNG, settings rebinding after case reimport, invalid refusals, API video 4 frames/3 distinct images and GUI creation/1280x640 native preview/user playback ending 2.738 s/cancel/restart. After GUI completion/cancel/restart, the original 2.01 s interpolated viewer, input, cases and panel were exactly unchanged. Download was clicked once but timed out awaiting completion, which is unverified. Localhost real Chrome verified opt-in saving, candidate retention after reload, explicit restoration after case reimport with new IDs, disable/delete and no candidate resurrection after another reload; main viewer/input/cases stayed unchanged. Forced storage failures have automated coverage only. Added stored-time thermal-temperature/transient-acoustic WebM with fixed camera/whole-period range, nearest stored times and offsets and explicit physical endpoints; localhost real-Chrome thermal time video passed API VP9/1280x640/SHA validation with four frames/four images, GUI creation/play/cancel/restart and exact restoration of all four states including the original 2.01 s interpolation; real-browser acoustic time video remains unverified. Added linear-elastic displacement/stress deformation WebM with one-way linear visualization multiplier 0 to requested scale, fixed camera/range/saved result, not a physical load history; earlier partial real-Chrome evidence is retained and supplemented by current API proof. Added comparison orbit GIF (24 fixed frames,640x320,RGB332256 colors; localhost Chrome verified API SHA/24 decoded images and GUI create/cancel/restart/four-state equality); time/deformation GIF added2026-10-19 (latest update); MP4 is not implemented; smooth 24 fps, public HTTPS, general geometry and installed-MCP execution remain unverified. Additional low-load localhost Chrome verified API24,858 bytes/SHA, VP9/1280x640, four decoded frames/four images, independent geometry-only change and four-state equality, plus separate GUI playback ending2.125s. Earlier partial evidence is retained. Accepted jobs detach original admission expiry; real Chrome15s request completed at15,725ms with92,321 bytes/SHA/17 frames17 images/geometry change/four-state equality. Disconnect during this recording has automated coverage only.

entries.parentAcceptance: 現在の確認範囲: 2026-10-17: 実Chromeで熱の0/5/10秒3枚PNG連番、画像差・ZIP/画像ハッシュ・物理時刻・出力後2秒復元を確認。小規模ローカル試験のみ。補間表示の復元は自動テストで確認。slice/容量上限/120枚/公開HTTPSは未確認。 過去の検証履歴（以下の状態・未解決記述は各記録時点のもの）: 全体373件中370成功・3スキップ。実MCP/ChromeでPNG77,944バイト2分割とWebM8,795バイトをハッシュ照合、中止後の表示復元・成果物拒否を確認。1秒動画は背景タブで2フレーム。固定フレーム・MP4/GIF・永続化は未完了。公開HTTPS接続の検証はPUBLICHTTPS1で追跡する。 2026-10-16: 固定フレームPNG連番(ZIP、2〜120枚、軌道/変形/時間)をmainへ反映(PR63)。実Chromeで構造・過渡音響のZIP解析、CRC、フレームSHA、中止後の表示復元、拒否、非選択タブでの完走を確認。軌道のmanifestが初回のみ最終桁で異なる不具合を見つけコードで修正済み(単体テストのみ、実Chrome再確認は未実施)。slice、容量上限境界、120枚成功、MP4/GIFは未検証。 2026-10-16 追記: 実Chromeで再確認。軌道書き出しは同一結果内でZIP完全一致(修正済み)、構造結果へのtime指定は開始時に拒否。ただし同じデモを解き直すとresultRevisionが変わりZIPも変わる(保存済み結果ごとの決定性のみ。原因未調査)。重い環境では8枚の書き出しに20〜180秒、開始が15秒の接続上限でタイムアウトし、ジョブが残って上限到達する場面があった。checking維持。 2026-10-16 実Chromeで再確認: 解き直しても軌道書出しのZIPが一致(physicalRevision、manifest v2)。ただしページ言語状態の変化でキャプション文字が変わると1枚目が変わる。slice、容量上限境界、120枚成功、MP4/GIFは未検証。checking維持。
entries.parentAcceptanceEn: Current verified scope: 2026-10-17: Real Chrome verified a 3-frame thermal PNG sequence at 0/5/10 s, distinct images, ZIP/frame hashes, physical times and restore to 2 s. Small local fixture only; interpolation restore is automated-test coverage. Slice/size-limit/120-frame/public-HTTPS checks remain pending. Historical verification (statuses and unresolved observations below describe their recording dates): 370 passed, three skipped of373. Real MCP/Chrome verified hashed PNG77944 bytes/two pages, WebM8795 bytes, cancellation restoration and artifact refusal. Background one-second video had two frames. Fixed-frame export, MP4/GIF and persistence remain unfinished. Published-HTTPS verification is tracked in PUBLICHTTPS1. 2026-10-16: Fixed-frame PNG sequence (ZIP, 2-120 frames, orbit/deformation/time) merged (PR 63). Real Chrome verified ZIP parsing, CRCs, frame hashes, cancel restoration, refusals and an undriven-tab run for structural and transient acoustic results. An orbit manifest last-digit difference on the first export was fixed in code (unit-tested only; real-Chrome re-check pending). slice, size-limit boundaries, a 120-frame success and MP4/GIF are not verified. 2026-10-16 addendum: re-checked in real Chrome. Orbit exports are byte-identical ZIPs within one stored result (fixed) and time on a structural result is refused at start. A fresh solve of the same demo gives a different resultRevision and therefore a different ZIP (determinism holds per stored result only; cause not investigated). On a loaded machine an 8-frame export took 20-180 s, and start calls hit the 15 s connector limit, leaving held jobs until the page was reloaded. Stays checking. 2026-10-16 Re-verified in real Chrome: orbit export ZIPs are identical across fresh solves (physicalRevision, manifest v2); caption text can still change with the page language state (e.g. browser translation). slice, size-limit boundaries, a 120-frame success and MP4/GIF are unverified. Stays checking.

entries.parentAcceptance: 失敗時の実行条件・Worker/WASM終了状態を捕捉し、固定条件で再現と原因を検証する。再試行成功だけで解決扱いしない。 2026-10-16 追跡: 上流nodejs/node#66366はV8の競合(WasmImportWrapperCacheのMaybeGetがis_dying確認前にrefを取る)が原因とされ、修正はV8 68210d500a/9b8ca54d5aだが、24.xへのバックポート(PR66376)は未マージで、24.21.0・24.22.0とも修正を含まない(CHANGELOG確認)。当方のWindows実測(Node 24.11.1/24.22.0/22.23.3/26.12.0と--no-wasm-code-gc、CIで落ちた5ファイルを93回)ではV8致命エラー0回で、当方のどの操作が引き金かは未特定(worker.terminate()後のWASM保持という仮説のみ)。推奨: 24.xの修正入りリリースへのCIピン移行を待つ。暫定策として--no-wasm-code-gc(上流報告では0/20)はCI変更の承認が必要。checking維持。
entries.parentAcceptanceEn: Capture environment and Worker/WASM teardown state, reproduce with frozen conditions and verify root cause. Successful retry alone is not resolution. 2026-10-16 Tracking: upstream nodejs/node#66366 attributes the crash to a V8 race (WasmImportWrapperCache MaybeGet takes a ref before checking is_dying); V8 fixes 68210d500a/9b8ca54d5a, but the 24.x backport (PR 66376) is unmerged and neither 24.21.0 nor 24.22.0 contains it (CHANGELOG checked). Our Windows runs (Node 24.11.1, 24.22.0, 22.23.3, 26.12.0 and --no-wasm-code-gc; the five files that died in CI; 93 runs) produced 0 V8 fatals, so which operation of ours triggers it is not identified (hypothesis only: wasm kept alive across worker.terminate()). Recommendation: move the CI pin to the first 24.x release with the fix. Interim --no-wasm-code-gc (0/20 in the upstream report) needs an approved CI change. Stays checking.
